subject: SummitEdge + Redwood: partner-led technical demo & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@summitedge.io>; SummitEdge Partnerships <partners@summitedge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: SummitEdge + Redwood: partner-led technical demo & next steps

Hi Olivia / SummitEdge team,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — appreciated the context on your marketplace roadmap and how you want partner listings to behave across provisioning and billing. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a date for the partner-led demo you offered to run: 

Summary (from our side):
- You’re interested in a marketplace connector that can (a) surface model metadata, (b) manage per-tenant routing policies, and (c) optionally route fallbacks to a hosted Redwood variant.
- Primary success criteria: predictable latency for listing previews, predictable costs per invocation, and auditability for enterprise customers (SAML + audit logs).

Proposed next steps:
1) Partner-led technical demo (60 min) — SummitEdge to lead, Redwood to bring SE for Q&A (Jonas) and AE for commercial details (Ben).
2) Pre-demo intake — we attached a short intake questionnaire and a mutual action plan (MAP) to scope integration touchpoints. Please fill the questionnaire so Jonas can prepare the demo scenarios.
3) Dates — can you run the demo the week of Nov 1? We have the following windows available (PT):
   - Tue Nov 2: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
   - Wed Nov 3: 09:00–11:00
   - Thu Nov 4: 09:00–12:00

If none of those work, tell us your preferred slots and we’ll align. Also please confirm who from SummitEdge will present (engineering, product, or partnerships).

Attachments: SummitEdge-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx; Pre-demo-Intake-Questions.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold a couple of provisional blocks until you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

---
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@summitedge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SummitEdge Partnerships <partners@summitedge.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitEdge + Redwood: partner-led technical demo & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments.

We’re happy to run the demo and will focus on the connector behavior and tenant routing use case you outlined. Attendees from our side will be: myself (partnerships), Ravi Kumar (lead engineer), and Priya Shah (product).

Availability: we prefer the morning slot on Wed Nov 3 or Thu Nov 4. Ravi is travelling on Nov 2. Can we tentatively lock Wed Nov 3 at 09:30 PT? If that works for you, we’ll send a calendar invite with a proposed agenda and a short 10-minute pre-demo tech checklist (what access we’ll need).

I attached our proposed agenda for the session (SummitEdge-Proposed-Agenda.pdf). Two quick asks from our engineering team before the demo:
- Can Redwood provide a short list of expected API endpoints and an example tenant schema?
- Is it possible to enable a temporary demo tenant or service account so we can show end-to-end provisioning?

We’ll send the invite once you confirm the time. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of Partnerships | SummitEdge
olivia.grant@summitedge.io
Attachments: SummitEdge-Proposed-Agenda.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@summitedge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitEdge + Redwood: partner-led technical demo & next steps

Marissa / Olivia —

Thanks — Jonas here (SE at Redwood). I can join the demo; my availability on Wed Nov 3 is 09:00–11:00 PT, so 09:30 PT works fine for me. A couple of notes so I can prepare demos that match SummitEdge’s needs: 

Technical asks (from Redwood SE):
- If SummitEdge can share a minimal API spec or a sample tenant payload (JSON) we’ll mock end-to-end provisioning flows.
- For the demo we’ll show a marketplace listing -> model routing -> tenant-specific override -> fallback path. If you want us to include quantization/throughput benchmarks, tell us expected sequence lengths / request volumes so we can pick realistic batch sizes.
- SSO/SSO metadata: if you plan to demo SAML flows, please share IdP test metadata or allow a short SSO setup window the day before.

I’m attaching a short tech checklist we use for partner-led demos (link below). If you can populate the intake questionnaire Marissa attached, that’ll speed prep.

Helpful link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SE/Partner-Demo-Checklist

Thanks — I’ll prepare a couple of scenarios and sample curl commands.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

Thanks Olivia — locked.

Final schedule:
- Demo: Wed, Nov 3, 2026 — 09:30–10:30 PT
- Owner: SummitEdge to present (Ravi + Priya); Redwood SE (Jonas) for live Q&A and edge-case walkthroughs; AE (Ben) to cover commercial questions.

What we’ll do before the session:
- SummitEdge: send the calendar invite and the short pre-demo checklist you mentioned (Ravi — please include any test tenant credentials or IdP metadata as attachments).
- Redwood: we’ll review your intake answers and prepare two tenant-specific scenarios (provision + fallback). Jonas will record the curl snippets and a short runbook for post-demo handoff.

Attachments: SummitEdge-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (updated with the Nov 3 slot)

Links / calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-summitedge-demo-20261103

Marissa Cole
